plugin.name: Claude Usage
actions.claude-usage.name: Claude Usage
actions.claude-weekly-usage.name: Claude Weekly Usage
claude-usage.command.title: ccusage command
claude-usage.command.subtitle: How to invoke ccusage, e.g. "npx --yes ccusage@latest" or just "ccusage" if installed globally
claude-usage.token-limit.title: Token limit for 100%
claude-usage.token-limit.subtitle: Tokens that count as the full 5-hour limit for your plan. Leave at 0 to just show the raw token count instead of a percentage.
claude-usage.refresh.title: Refresh interval (seconds, min. 15)
claude-usage.show-cost.title: Show cost instead of time remaining
claude-usage.show-cost.subtitle: Bottom label shows the cost (USD) instead of the time left
claude-weekly.token-limit.title: Token limit for 100%
claude-weekly.token-limit.subtitle: Tokens that count as your plan's full weekly limit. This is a rough estimate - Anthropic's actual weekly cap is based on compute time, not raw tokens. Leave at 0 to just show the raw token count instead of a percentage.
claude-weekly.start-of-week.title: Week starts on
claude-weekly.start-of-week.subtitle: Should match the day your account's weekly limit actually resets on, not necessarily Monday/Sunday
